appDescription: A greeting app for senior drivers that tells their family when they depart and arrive, and reads the driver a weekly driving diary.

function.name: SEND_DEPARTURE_NOTE
function.description: Send a short note to the driver's family saying that the driver is departing now, with the expected arrival time when it is known.

destination.description: The saved place the driver is heading to.

function.name: SEND_ARRIVAL_NOTE
function.description: Send a note to the driver's family saying that the driver has arrived safely, after a ten second window in which the driver can cancel.

function.name: READ_WEEKLY_DIARY
function.description: Show and read aloud the driver's weekly driving diary, which compares this week's driving with the driver's own usual pattern. It is available only while the car is parked.
